name_en: Kirazu Mochi — mochi rice stretched with tofu pulp, wrapped around sweet red bean
summary_ja: もち米とおから（きらず）を混ぜた生地であんこを包む佐川町尾川地区だけに伝わる菓子。正月前の豆腐づくりで出るおからを使い、縁を「切らず」に通じる縁起物としても振る舞われてきたという。
summary_en: Sticky rice dough stretched with tofu pulp, called kirazu locally, is wrapped around sweet red bean paste — a confection passed down only in the Ogawa district of Sakawa Town. Made from the pulp left over from pre-New Year's tofu-making, it was also served as a good-luck food, its name playing on "not cutting" a bond.
source_title: きらずもち 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Imobera Azuki — dried sweet potato slow-simmered soft and folded with sweet red bean
summary_ja: さつまいもを丸ごと煮てから干し、輪切りにしてさらに干した「ゆでべら」を小豆とともに甘く煮る伊野町の菓子。他地域では「東山」と呼ぶ同じ干し芋を使い、農作業の合間のおやつになったという。
summary_en: Sweet potato is boiled whole, dried, sliced into rounds, and dried again into what's called yudebera, then simmered sweet with red bean — a confection from Ino Town. The same dried potato goes by "Higashiyama" elsewhere in Kochi, and it once served as a snack eaten between stretches of farm work.
source_title: いもべらあずき 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Konchin — burdock kneaded into wheat batter and pan-fried into a snack
summary_ja: ささがきにしたごぼうを中力粉の生地にたっぷり混ぜ、フライパンで両面を焼く大豊町のおやつ。米がとれない時期に主食とされた地粉（中力粉）を用いるとされ、皿鉢料理の一品にもなるという。
summary_en: Shaved burdock is worked generously into a batter of medium-strength wheat flour and pan-fried on both sides — a snack from Otoyo Town. It's said to use the same local wheat flour that once stood in for rice when it was scarce, and it also finds a place on sawachi platters.
source_title: こんちん 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Hange Dango — a wheat dumpling wrapped in myoga leaf, made for the day farm labor gets a rest
summary_ja: 小麦粉の生地であんこを包み、みょうがの葉で包んで蒸す大豊町の郷土菓子。7月2日の「半夏」に農作業の労をねぎらってつくられ、田んぼの神様にも供えるとされる。「みょうがだんご」とも呼ばれる。
summary_en: Wheat dough is wrapped around sweet red bean, then wrapped again in a myoga leaf and steamed — a confection from Otoyo Town. It's made on hange, July 2nd, to mark a rest from farm labor, and is said to be offered to the paddy field's guardian deity too. It also goes by the name myoga dango.
source_title: 半夏だんご 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
